crossRefs.note: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Moab_Plains
people.line: Region east of the Jordan River, opposite Jericho

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
translations.bsb: They brought the captives, spoils, and plunder to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of Israel at the camp on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.
translations.kjv: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
translations.asv: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and unto Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
